task.title: P6-068: Stop query refresh from re-suspending the auth guard and unmounting the /my/* subtree
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, /my collection page, tree and collection header). Original id: P6-068. Size: M. Specs: specs/app-ui.md. **Stop `/my/collections/:id`'s query refresh from re-suspending the auth guard, which unmounts the whole `/my/*` subtree on every `?q=` navigation.** Diagnosed 2026-07-28 (`specs/phase-6-probes/P6-068.md`, CONFIRMED — the original entry's "find what this route does" ask is answered). **Mechanism:** `CollectionPage` reads `view_res` in its **setup body** — the `Effect` at `app/src/my/collection.rs:217` and the `resolved` memo at `:232` — outside both of the page's own `Transition`s. Resource reads register against whatever `SuspenseContext` is in the owner chain (`arc_async_derived.rs:629-667`) and re-suspend it on every re-run, so the boundary that gets re-suspended is `RequireAuth`'s `` (`app/src/shell.rs:122`); `SuspenseBoundary` swaps to its fallback and `EitherKeepAlive` unmounts the entire ``. **Not the router** — `nested_router.rs:152-162` returns early on a query-only navigation. Symptoms: the focused field blurs, and any showing native popover is removed without firing `toggle`, so the Rust `open` signal desyncs (`app/src/components/popover.rs:200-242`). The entry's "rebuilds the DOM per search" was **wrong**: `EitherKeepAlive` unmounts and re-inserts the *same* nodes. **Fix — Option B (M), chosen 2026-07-28 over the one-token alternative.** Making `RequireAuth` a `` would hide the symptom while leaving the mis-wiring, and becomes an active hazard the moment `CurrentUserResource` is made refetchable (it is `Resource::new(|| (), …)` over a constant source today and never refetches, which is the only reason that alternative is currently harmless). Instead **remove the cause**: have the page's existing `Transition` bodies (`collection.rs:282-300`, `:333-369`) write plain `RwSignal`s, and let the out-of-boundary consumers (`QuickAddPanel` at `:288`, the `here_delta` reset at `:321-323`) read those. `ArcRwSignal`'s read path does no `SuspenseContext` lookup at all, so a query refresh can no longer reach the guard. **Traps.** (1) Moving a read into an `Effect` is **not** a fix — registration ignores `in_effect_scope()`, which only silences the warning. (2) A nearer boundary in the view tree is **structurally impossible**: `view!` starts at `:262`, and the setup body runs under `CollectionPage`'s owner, an *ancestor* of every boundary in its view. (3) Moving the consumers inside a boundary instead is blocked by the deliberate constraint at `:264-267` — the query bar sits outside both Transitions so a rebuild cannot rebuild the `` under the caret. (4) A `provide_context(SuspenseContext { … })` decoy boundary works in ~2 lines but silently shadows the whole subtree; do not ship it unannotated. **What makes it M rather than S** (~40-55 lines, one file): the `here_delta` invariant (`:206-221`) — header and table are two separate boundaries awaiting the same resource, so whichever site writes the reset now decides the ordering the invariant is about; and `resolved` today collapses to `None` mid-search, which is what makes `⏎` hit quick-add's "Still loading this collection" guard (`quick_add.rs:449-455`) — a retained signal keeps the last destination instead, arguably better but a behavior change on the keystroke loop. **Acceptance:** typing in the query bar leaves `div[data-testid="collection-page"]` mounted throughout; focus and any open popover survive. Confirming observation for the diagnosis, if wanted before starting: during the gap today, `RequireAuth`'s `

Loading…

` (`shell.rs:123`) should be what occupies the subtree — if the space is empty instead, this diagnosis is wrong. Landing this makes the 120 ms focus keeper at `quick_add.rs:402-439` dead weight (sole call site `collection.rs:310`), and both `specs/app-ui.md:1602-1621` and `app/src/shell.rs:173-177` need correcting — they describe the cause as "the router".
